story.title: The Velvet Consul
story.subtitle: A farewell portrait session becomes a contest over a forged diplomatic identity.
story.premise: honorary consul Alain Rochefort's farewell portrait sitting before his supposed retirement brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Alain Rochefort; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.
story.hostRole: Alain Rochefort, honorary consul and keeper of unofficial passports; then Game Master

story.solution: Sylvie built Alain’s false diplomatic identity and feared the portrait archive would connect her to every passport it enabled. She poisoned him before the sitting and steered suspicion toward the photographer. The others independently place her at the origin of the forged seal and prove she knew the portrait’s hidden purpose.

clues.text: The consular seal predates Alain’s appointment by two years.
Sylvie recognized a deliberately reversed seal impression without being shown it.
The farewell portrait was intended as evidence for an internal inquiry.
A cottage guest register links the dead diplomat’s name to Sylvie’s old studio.
Alain was poisoned after announcing the portrait, not before the guests arrived.
